prompt: write a 4 page report on philosophy of mathematics  based on this article https://philosophynow.org/issues/19/What_is_the_Philosophy_of_Mathematics
judge_reasoning: Candidate [1] is the most faithful and coherent overall, covering the main positions (Platonism, nominalism, formalism/intuitionism, truth and proof) with relatively few clear factual misstatements, though it is truncated mid-report. Candidate [2] contains several concrete factual errors and misattributions (e.g., Gödel’s location; dubious claims about Gauss/Dedekind), but much of its general philosophical framing is still broadly recognizable. Candidates [3] and [4] introduce multiple commission-level false claims about what the Philosophy Now article says or about specific historical/technical facts (e.g., subjectivity claims attributed to the article; incorrect Gödel “completeness of arithmetic”; misdescriptions of Fermat’s Last Theorem and Cantor-related details). Overall, [1] best satisfies correctness and relevance despite being incomplete.
